rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402 and halting new event recordings after the 3rd. Live view remained functional because it does not depend on local storage. Enabling loop recording immediately restored new clip recording, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm loop recording is enabled in Base Station Settings > Storage.
Verify new event clips are being recorded and error E-402 is cleared.
Advise customer to export important clips before storage overwrites them if loop recording is on.
output.customer_reply: We identified the issue: your base station storage was full and loop recording was off, so new events couldn't be saved. I've enabled loop recording, and new clips are now being recorded. If you want to keep any existing clips, please export them soon, as loop recording will overwrite the oldest clips when storage is full. Let us know if you need further help!

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.
